assignments.title: Keep assignments moving

audience.question: Who is {{appName}} for?
audience.answer: {{appName}} supports school staff and authorized students with everyday classroom workflows. School registration creates an administrator account; existing users should sign in through their school.

signIn.question: How do I sign in to my school?
signIn.answer: Choose Sign in, or use Find your school to open its sign-in page. Follow your school's account instructions and any configured Google sign-in requirements.

tools.question: Which learning tools are included?
tools.answer: Availability depends on the school's plan and settings. Some AI actions also use credits. A school registration or demo request does not unlock every tool.

ai.question: Does AI replace teacher review?
ai.answer: No. AI-generated content can be incorrect and should be checked before relying on it. Review and sharing controls differ between tools; not every response waits for teacher approval.

demo.question: Does a demo request create an account or reserve a time?
demo.answer: No. It saves an enquiry for the team to review. It does not create a school account, reserve an appointment, or confirm an email delivery. School registration is separate.

language.question: Does the interface support English and Arabic?
language.answer: The interface supports English and Arabic, including right-to-left Arabic layouts. Language support for individual learning and audio tools can differ.
